subject: Marine Works - Lake Simcoe, Trent-Severn Waterway - Sutton
text:
Marine Works - Lake Simcoe, Trent-Severn Waterway - Sutton
Dredging operations, diving operations and pipeline installation taking place daily 24 hours a day.
Pipeline is afloat and extending from 44 18.950N 079 25.069W to 44 19.701N 079 24.947W and is equipped with flashing amber lights. Barges and tug on scene.
